senses.gloss:
Jaiyaṭa
or Jajjaṭa or Jejjaṭa or Jaijjaṭa. writer on med.; pupil of Vāgbhaṭa according to one tradition, but prob. 9th Cent. See Āyurved kā Bṛhad Itihās p. 200.
--C. Nirantarapadavyākhyā on Carakasam3hitā. See Jajjaṭa; also NCC. VI. p. 397b.
--C. on Suśrutasam3hitā. Bikaner. 4391. Mentioned by Niścalakara in C. on Cikitsāsaṅgraha. See IHQ. XXIII. ii. p. 142.
For a ms. of the revised text of Suśruta made by Candraṭa on the basis of Jaiyaṭa see IO. 2646. Also Oxf. 357b.
Q. by Hemādri in his C. on Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya, IO. 2656; by Vijayarakṣita in his C. Madhukośa on Mādhavanidāna or Rugviniścaya. Bomb. Uni. 219. C.. X. A. 86. IO. 2668; by Ṭoḍarānanda in Āyurvedasaukhya, Weber 941; by Nāganātha in his Nidānapradīpa, IO. 2671 (the same ref. to a. C. on Mādhavanidāna in Bik. 1422); by Rūpanayana in Yogaśata an. C., IO. 2757. [Page318-a.

Jaiyaṭa
father of Kaiyaṭa (a. of C. Pradīpa on Mahābhāṣya).
See NCC. V. p. 75b.
